notes.title: OmegaBot release date - 16th of June
notes.notes:
OmegaBot Release Date is set to 16th of June

Hello everyone! I'm happy to finally announce the release date of OmegaBot.

I've put my heart and a lot of time into it, so I really really hope you'll enjoy it :)

And if you want to try out a small piece of the game, check out the Demo version! But be quick It'll be gone after OmegaBot releases ;)

notes.title: NEW Update: Controller Support added to OmegaBot DEMO
notes.notes:
Hi there! So there have been some complains about not having cotroller support for demo of OmegaBot, 
 which is now fully supported.

 All the things added/changed
- Full Controller Support
- Game now Starts in fullscreen
- Pause Menu rebinded to "ESC"
- Fixed bug where you would fall from the game world with no way to recover

You can see the changes after updating the game (which should be done automatically)
Let me know if what you think, and what  should be changed, I'm always open to suggestions ;)
